name: How should a homeowner prepare before consulting an ADU contractor?
description: Locate your property survey, define your intended use and budget, and note essential features like accessible bathrooms or specific kitchen requirements.

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before consulting an ADU contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, gather your property survey, identify your primary goals for the space, and establish a clear budget range. A boundary survey helps identify property lines, easements, and setback limits on your parcel. It is also beneficial to list your must-have functional features, such as walk-in showers or specific kitchen layouts for aging relatives, and identify existing electrical panel capacity and main sewer line locations to help guide early feasibility evaluations.
